shortDescription: generates a self-signed certificate using SSH protocol with SSH key

options.name: cert_cn
options.description: Certificate CN (common name) embedded in the certificate signature.

options.name: cert_friendly_name
options.description: Human friendly certificate name (not CN but just a friendly name).

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IP address (or hostname) of PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: key_filename
options.description: Location of the filename that is used for the auth. Either I(key_filename) or I(password) is required.

options.name: password
options.description: Password credentials to use for auth. Either I(key_filename) or I(password) is required.

options.name: rsa_nbits
options.description: Number of bits used by the RSA algorithm for the certificate generation.

options.name: signed_by
options.description: Undersigning authority (CA) that MUST already be presents on the device.

options.name: username
options.description: User name to use for auth. Default is admin.
